summary: Teaches deploying a Grafana alert rule, contact point and notification policy with Terraform using a service account token.

needs.description: Terraform >=1.0 CLI on the learner's machine to run plan/apply against the stack
needs.evidence: Before you begin: Terraform installed (version 1.0 or later)

needs.description: A Prometheus data source (or grafana-testdata-datasource) whose UID is used as datasource_uid in the rule
needs.evidence: Before you begin: A data source configured; note on grafana-testdata-datasource

needs.description: User able to create service accounts/tokens (Admin) and manage alerting
needs.evidence: Before you begin: Admin or Editor permissions; create-service-account milestone

reviewNotes: Steps run in a local terminal; no in-UI requirements in dossier. Terraform apply is outside the browser so E2E can only cover UI steps (service account, verify).
